# Windless Technologies

> A custom software consulting company: 100% hand-coded websites, mobile
> apps, and e-commerce platforms - no WordPress, no page builders.

Windless Technologies builds custom-coded web and mobile software for
small businesses, startups, and service companies. Every project is
written from scratch rather than assembled from a template or page
builder, which the company treats as its core technical differentiator:
faster load times, no third-party plugin vulnerabilities, clean
SEO-ready markup, and an architecture that scales with the business
instead of being outgrown.

## Services

- **Web Design & Development** - a one-time Lump Sum build (starting at
  $4,000), an ongoing Monthly Package ($200/mo covering design, hosting,
  development, and support), or a custom E-commerce Package (starting at
  $7,000, Shopify or fully custom).
- **Mobile App Development** - cross-platform iOS and Android apps built
  in Flutter, offered as Basic ($10,000 / 8 weeks), Standard ($15,000 /
  10 weeks), or Premium ($20,000 / 16 weeks) packages.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://windlesstechnologies.com/): Overview, service pricing,
  why custom code, and featured case studies.
- [Services](https://windlesstechnologies.com/services): Full pricing
  breakdown for web, e-commerce, and mobile app packages, plus add-ons.
- [Portfolio](https://windlesstechnologies.com/portfolio): Case studies -
  Lunar Mart (e-commerce), Orbit CRM (custom CRM), and Stellar App
  (mobile task management).
- [About](https://windlesstechnologies.com/about): Mission, vision, core
  values, and leadership.
- [Careers](https://windlesstechnologies.com/careers): The invite-only
  internship program (software engineering and UI/UX tracks) and how to
  apply.
- [Contact](https://windlesstechnologies.com/contact): Project inquiry
  form.

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Contact form:** Server-side validated and rate-limited, delivered via
  email
